scale.1: Easy — urban/community ponds, full facilities, roadside access
scale.2: Fair — road-accessible lakes with basic amenities
scale.3: Moderate — gravel roads, remote drives, mine pits, limited facilities
scale.4: Hard — hike or bike access, backcountry trails

difficulty.methodology: Ratings derived from My Wild Alberta stocking map site amenities and descriptions (access, remoteness, facilities), with name/type heuristics and manual overrides where MWA has no listing.
